about: Labelled checklist items for measuring which source can answer an item: 'app' (seen in a signed-in app), 'code' (seen in the code), 'both', or 'neither' (policy, process, organisation, offline). Labels come from a person reading the item, never from running a classifier. 'also' lists a second answer that is just as fair for a genuinely mixed item. This file is the one copy: the frontend reads it through evidenceKind.samples.ts, and the backend benchmark (npm run benchmark:classify) reads it directly.

groups.tuning: Written first. They shaped the first keyword lists of the old keyword classifier.
groups.round_two: Written as a held-out set after the first keyword lists, then used to widen them.
groups.round_three: Written as a held-out set after the second keyword lists, then used to fix them.
groups.held_out: Written after the last keyword change and never used to change any rule.
